templates.name: app_automation_workflow
templates.title: App 自动化决策流程
templates.description: 从钉钉打卡自动化中提取的通用决策模式。任何'自动操作App X'的任务都应走这个流程：先检查API可用性→无API则检查急速模式→仍不行则模拟点击→都不行则人工介入。避免在错误方向上探索。
templates.author: platform

templates.name: long_form_writer
templates.title: 万字长文生成器
templates.description: 分章节并行生成长文并自动拼接润色。工作流化解决单次LLM输出长度限制：先生成大纲→迭代生成每章→聚合→全文润色。适用于技术文档、分析报告、教程等。
templates.author: platform

templates.name: code_reviewer
templates.title: 代码审查与修复
templates.description: 标准代码审查工作流: 读取源码 → 运行测试 → 定位失败根因 → 最小修改 → 重新验证 → 生成报告。这是最核心的软件开发质量保证流程。
templates.author: platform

templates.name: task_decomposer
templates.title: 任务分解与规划
templates.description: 将复杂任务分解为可执行的子任务并按依赖排序。输入任务描述→LLM拆解→提取子任务→依赖排序→生成格式化计划。
templates.author: platform

templates.name: data_analyzer
templates.title: 数据分析流水线
templates.description: 标准数据分析工作流：加载数据→统计摘要→异常检测→生成报告。适用于CSV/JSON数据的自动化分析场景。
templates.author: platform

templates.name: document_summarizer
templates.title: 文档摘要生成器
templates.description: 阅读文档并生成多层级摘要：一句话总结→三段要点→完整摘要。适用于合同、论文、长文等场景。

build_plan.goal: Build and validate an editable customer support routing BlockFlow from scratch with reuse_depth=none.
build_plan.strategy: Call template_suggestions with reuse_depth=none to prove intentional template disable, then build every node from scratch: Start → Question Classifier → branches for complaint/question/feedback/urgent → model turns or templates for each path → Variable Aggregator join → Template Transform for final response → Answer/End. Add mandatory tests with required_node_types for auditability.

modules.title: Input & Classification
modules.purpose: Start node with customer_message and customer_tier inputs, Question Classifier routing to four branches
evidence: start node declares customer_message and customer_tier
classifier routes to 4 branches with edge filtering

modules.title: Branch Handlers
modules.purpose: Each branch (complaint, question, feedback, urgent) generates intent, priority, and response text
evidence: 8 branch template nodes: 4 for response text, 4 for priority
Priority templates output hardcoded priority strings

modules.title: Aggregation & Final Output
modules.purpose: Variable Aggregator joins branches, Template Transform formats final output, End/Answer node
evidence: aggregator joins response branches with first_non_null
priority_aggregator joins priority branches with first_non_null
End node returns intent, response, priority as named outputs

modules.title: Validation & Tests
modules.purpose: Mandatory test with required_node_types proving visible architecture

risks: Branch wiring must handle four mutually exclusive branches with optional references
Variable Aggregator must use optional refs for mutually exclusive branches
Tests must enforce visible architecture via required_node_types and not permit a single opaque agent

input.requirement: customer support routing workflow that classifies messages into complaint, question, feedback, or urgent and routes them differently, producing intent, priority, and response text
